patches.reason: "You earned yourself a punish point." calls punish() without the count; Groovy passes null, and punish's 1..i loop fails on 1..null. Every other caller passes the points it announces; pass 1.

inform awards "5 punish points only for thinking about quitting" with punish(5), but unlike its sibling scripts it never defines punish, and script-local closures are not shared, so Groovy failed there. Add the same punish closure that sleep.groovy defines.

eat's ben-wa-balls feedback raises or lowers chanceBenWaBalls and saves it as domme2.chanceBenWaBalls, but only chores declares and loads that variable, so Groovy failed on the first ++/--. Load it at the top of eat as chores does, with the same default of 8 for a profile that has none yet (see chores-ben-wa-default).

chores reads domme2.chanceBenWaBalls into an int, which fails on a fresh profile because nothing has saved the key yet (only chores and eat save it, and chores reads it first). Its next lines raise any value below 8 to 8 and save it, so 8 is the value the tease starts with: read into an Integer and default a missing key to 8.
